beats.summary: Michael announces the death of Ed Truck to the office.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Attention, everybody. I just received a call from corporate with some news they felt that I should know first. My old boss Ed Truck has died.

beats.summary: Michael struggles with how to honor Ed Truck after his death.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Well, we are talking about how to properly honor a man who gave his life as regional manager of this company, Jan.
Michael: I think that is a great way to honor Ed.

beats.summary: Creed describes the cause of Ed Truck's death.

evidence.snippet: Creed: He was drunk as a skunk, he was flying down Route 6. He slides under an 18 wheeler. Pop. It snaps right off.

beats.summary: Michael reflects on Ed Truck's role in his life and the office.

beats.summary: Michael considers a statue or robot to honor Ed Truck.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Well, I think it would be very realistic, it would look just like him.
Jan (on speakerphone): So, I wanted to let you know that we lost Ed Truck.

notable_quotes.quote: That's not a statue, that is a robot.
notable_quotes.speaker: Dwight

evidence.snippet: Dwight: And how big do you want this robot?
Michael: But Ed truck can't because he is—
